text.p: --Chicago Corp said on Monday it has downgraded its rating on Frontier Corp to hold from buy.
--Analyst Eric Strumingher said in a statement that the firm is downgrading Frontier based on a lower valuation assumption and lower earnings per share estimates.
--He lowered the fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.42 a share from $0.46, and the 1997 estimate to $1.84 from $2.00, on lower gross margin assumptions.

--Strumingher said the stock is trading at about 14.5 times 1997 earnings per share estimates and is fairly valued. --Frontier, a holding company for telecommunications services subsidiaries, was off 3/8 at 26-1/8.
